p: Jude — Among the apostles there were two who bore this name, (1) Judas (Jude 1:1; Matt.
Jude, Epistle of — The author was “Judas, the brother of James” the Less (Jude 1:1), called also Lebbaeus (Matt.
Archangel — 4:16; Jude 1:9), the prince of the angels.
Michael — He disputed with Satan (Jude 1:9) about the body of Moses.
Stars — 37:9); the seven (Amos 5:8); wandering (Jude 1:13); seen in the east at the birth of Christ, probably some luminous meteors miraculously formed for this specific purpose (Matt.
Enoch — He was the “seventh from Adam” (Jude 1:14), as distinguished from the son of Cain, the third from Adam.
Saint — The “saints” spoken of in Jude 1:14 are probably not the disciples of Christ, but the “innumerable company of angels” (Heb.
Enoch — He is spoken of in the catalogue of Old Testament worthies in the Epistle to the Hebrews (11:5).
